verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for accounting software, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows Zoho Books can be self-hosted: it is documented only as a cloud service with regional zohoapis.com endpoints and a sign-in-gated hosted MCP. The mobile and desktop apps are clients of that service, not self-hosted deployments.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
